integrity.computational_checks: standalone check.py independently compares monomial isomorphism and relational isomorphism in finite test cases
integrity.proof_basis: monomial rigidity, exact two-relation encoding, incidence-graph hardness construction

scientific_limitations: Only fixed finite fields: the cyclic-fiber graph has size proportional to field order, not necessarily to its bit length.
Perfection is essential to monomial rigidity; nonperfect algebras are not classified.
No polynomial-time graph-isomorphism algorithm is claimed.
A previously implicit GI equivalence in general graphical encodings is a residual originality risk.
title: Graph-isomorphism completeness of perfect evolution-algebra isomorphism over fixed finite fields
